rows.label: Straight tape span
rows.note: end-to-end only, curves ignored · range 225–230 mm

method: Same terrace crack photographed with a coin in frame, then measured three ways per the report: straight tape end-to-end (227 mm), pin-to-pin segments summed to 27.4 cm, and a thread-and-pin path (238.8 mm) read on a different horizontal crack with no coin in frame — not directly comparable to this crack. Snapclaim prediction for the terrace crack is 232 mm.
outcome: Per the report: for curved cracks a path-following method (pin-to-pin) is preferred over a straight tape reading. The thread reading is to be repeated on this same crack and percentage errors calculated — straight span (227) and pin-to-pin path (274) differ ~20%, so both cannot sit within 5% of one prediction. Full 5-page PDF with figures and the six-span table.
